channel.title: Paksh: Crime & Law
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Ex-CIA Official Pleads Guilty to $195 Million Fraud
item.description: A former CIA official has pleaded guilty to a $195 million fraud scheme involving gold bars. The official was found with over $40 million in gold bars. The fraud amount was stated as $195 million by one report and $194 million by another. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: US Marine Arrested in Okinawa Woman's Killing
item.description: A US Marine has been arrested in Okinawa, Japan, on suspicion of murdering a woman. The arrest has fueled growing anger in Japan over the presence of US military personnel on the island. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: ABC News challenges FCC's early license review in court
item.description: ABC News has asked a federal judge to block the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) from conducting an early review of its broadcast licenses. ABC News alleges this review is retaliation by the Trump administration. The network… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Cornell University Appoints Sally Yates to Lead Sex Abuse Review
item.description: Cornell University has announced that Sally Yates will lead an independent review into the university's handling of sexual misconduct claims. The review will be wide-ranging, examining the institution's response to such allegations. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: NFL Referees Union to Challenge Suspensions of Two Officials
item.description: The NFL Referees Association has announced it will challenge the severity of suspensions imposed on two officials. The union described the suspensions as 'excessive'. The challenge will be brought by the referees union. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Russian drone attack sinks ship in Romanian waters, Ukraine claims
item.description: Ukraine has stated that a Russian drone attack resulted in the sinking of a ship in Romanian waters. Ukrainian officials claim the attack occurred in the Black Sea. The ship was identified as a Turkish cargo vessel. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Missing Girl Found Dead in Worcestershire Park
item.description: An 11-year-old girl, who was reported missing, was found dead in a park in Worcestershire. Police have launched an investigation into her death. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Planes collide on LAX taxiway; FAA investigates
item.description: A Delta Air Lines plane and an Air Canada aircraft collided on a taxiway at Los Angeles International Airport (LAX). The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) is investigating the incident. No injuries were reported. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Toronto Police Seek Second Suspect in Fatal Vehicle Fire
item.description: Toronto police are seeking a second suspect in connection with a fatal vehicle fire that occurred in July. Two individuals have been charged in relation to the incident, which involved a vehicle fire. One suspect is currently wanted by… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Radio Host Accused of Indecent Assault After Renovating Teen's Home
item.description: Australian radio host Alan Jones is accused of indecent assault involving a teenager. The coverage states that Jones spent $85,000 renovating the teenager's home prior to the alleged assault. The Sydney Morning Herald reported on the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Asos Suffers Apparent Cyberattack, Customers Receive Rogue Messages
item.description: Online fashion retailer Asos has been subjected to an apparent cyberattack, during which hackers sent rogue messages to customers. The nature of the warning from the hackers has not been specified. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Senior Police Officer Charged with Impaired Driving
item.description: A senior police officer has been charged with impaired driving while off duty. The officer is with the Kingston Police. The Toronto Police Service also reported a senior officer charged with impaired driving. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Former 'American Idol' Singer Sentenced for Wife's Murder
item.description: Caleb Flynn, a former contestant on 'American Idol,' has been sentenced to life in prison for the murder of his wife. NBC News reported the sentence includes life without parole. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Dozens arrested in anti-migrant protest clashes with police
item.description: Dozens of people were arrested after anti-migrant protesters clashed with police in the seaside town of Gosport. The clashes occurred as a dinghy carrying migrants crossed the English Channel to the UK. Sky News reported that protesters… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: FBI Charges US Resident in Canadian School Shooting Plot
item.description: The FBI has charged a U.S. resident in connection with the Tumbler Ridge school shooting in Canada. Royal Canadian Mounted Police (RCMP) Assistant Commissioner stated that the U.S. resident's actions "helped facilitate" the attack. The New… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Prince Andrew Challenges UK Police Over Epstein-Related Searches
item.description: Prince Andrew is taking UK police to court to challenge search warrants and an arrest related to the Jeffrey Epstein case. He is seeking to have these actions "quashed". Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: England Goalkeeper Jordan Pickford Cited for Careless Driving
item.description: England goalkeeper Jordan Pickford was involved in an incident of careless driving in a Lamborghini, which reportedly "almost caused a crash." The incident involved a £200,000 supercar, described as having personalized plates. Specific… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Inmate Christa Pike Conscious After Botched Execution Attempt
item.description: Christa Pike, an inmate, is awake and conscious following a failed execution attempt. Her lawyers stated she is speaking and has been moved to a hospital. A doctor had previously warned Pike's lawyers that the execution method could be… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Aviation Incidents Reshaped Airline Security Post-9/11
item.description: Major aviation incidents since 2001, including the 9/11 attacks and the "shoe bomber" attempt, have led to significant changes in airline security protocols and cockpit access rules. These events have been pivotal in reshaping how air… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: FBI contractor removed over data breach exposing employee details
item.description: The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) removed an Accenture contractor on Monday due to their alleged involvement in a data breach that exposed sensitive personal details of thousands of bureau employees. Two sources familiar with the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Starbucks Sued Over Allegedly Misleading 'Sugar-Free' Drinks
item.description: Starbucks is facing a lawsuit alleging that some of its "sugar-free" beverages contain significant amounts of sugar. The lawsuit claims that certain drinks marketed as sugar-free actually contain as much sugar as a KitKat candy bar. The… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Russian drone strike kills one at Indian-owned pharma warehouse in Ukraine
item.description: A Russian drone strike hit a pharmaceutical warehouse in Ukraine, resulting in one fatality. The warehouse was reportedly owned by Indian individuals. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy condemned the attack and offered condolences to… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Denmark Data Breach Exposes Millions of Personal Details
item.description: A significant data breach in Denmark has exposed the personal details of 8.8 million people. The incident has been described as 'extremely serious' by authorities. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Italian PM Seeks Voice Trademark to Combat AI Deepfakes
item.description: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has filed to trademark her voice with an EU agency. The move is intended to protect her voice from being used in AI-generated deepfakes. Meloni submitted a four-second audio clip as part of the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Former German Spy Chief Arrested for Suspected Treasonous Espionage
item.description: Gerhard Schindler, former head of Germany's foreign intelligence agency, has been arrested on suspicion of treasonous espionage. He is accused of passing secret documents and allegedly provided money for them. The arrest was made by German… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Norway proposes temporary ban on AI smart glasses
item.description: Norway is planning to introduce a temporary ban on smart glasses, specifically mentioning Meta's camera-enabled spectacles, in public spaces due to privacy concerns. The government is preparing a bill to implement this restriction. These… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: Woman Arrested in US Accused of Spying for China on Taiwan President's Son
item.description: The FBI has arrested a woman in California on suspicion of acting as an agent for China and surveilling the son of Taiwan's president. The alleged agent was apprehended in the United States. Reports indicate the woman was accused of spying… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 6 · Right 1.

item.title: Form 6 Voter List Changes Spark Political and Legal Debate
item.description: A political and legal controversy has erupted over Form 6, related to voter lists, prompting questions about the Election Commission's actions. The debate centers on changes to the form and the mandatory inclusion of a declaration, with… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: CJI and EC Clash Over Form 6 Approval
item.description: Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant stated that any modified Form 6 has not been approved by the Supreme Court. In response, sources from the Election Commission (EC) defended Form 6, asserting that not a single comma had been changed… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: US State Designates CAIR a Terrorist Organization
item.description: Florida Governor Ron DeSantis and the state Cabinet have designated the Council on American-Islamic Relations (CAIR), along with the Muslim Brotherhood and Antifa, as terrorist organizations under Florida state law. The designation of… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: J&K authorities demolish Afzal Guru relative's house in Baramulla
item.description: Authorities in Jammu and Kashmir's Baramulla district have demolished a house belonging to a relative of Afzal Guru. The demolition was carried out by J&K authorities to remove an alleged illegal encroachment. The house was described as… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Projectile hits ship in Hormuz, injuring 11 Indians
item.description: A projectile struck the Indian-flagged vessel MT On Peace in the Hormuz Strait, injuring 11 Indian nationals. India has condemned the attack, which occurred near Oman. The specific nature of the projectile and the entity responsible have… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Maharashtra Approves Compensation for Custodial Deaths and Disabilities
item.description: The Maharashtra government has approved a policy to provide compensation for custodial deaths and permanent disabilities. The policy mandates a payment of Rs 5 lakh for deaths occurring in police custody. This development was reported by… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: SC may close case as TN Assembly withdraws 2003 resolution
item.description: The Supreme Court may close a reference concerning legislative privileges after the Tamil Nadu Assembly withdrew a 2003 resolution. The resolution had sought to define the scope of legislative privileges. The withdrawal means the case… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Supreme Court Questions Shiv Sena Symbol Allocation to Shinde Faction
item.description: The Supreme Court of India questioned the Eknath Shinde faction's claim to the Shiv Sena party symbol, referring to the act of defection as a 'constitutional sin'. The court's query was directed at the legitimacy of allocating the symbol… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Yo Yo Honey Singh Skips Maharashtra Cyber Police Summons
item.description: Rapper Yo Yo Honey Singh failed to appear before the Maharashtra Cyber Police on Tuesday, having been summoned in connection with alleged indecent remarks made during a concert in Delhi. The summons was issued by the Maharashtra Cyber… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Supreme Court seeks Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar's response on 'unilateral decisions'
item.description: The Supreme Court has asked Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar to respond to allegations of 'unilateral decisions' and has refused to suspend him. The court issued a notice in response to a petition filed against Kumar regarding his… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Supreme Court seeks 5 cities for footpath pilot project
item.description: The Supreme Court has directed the Central government to identify five cities to implement a pilot project for ensuring every road has a footpath. The court asked the Centre to identify the authority responsible for ensuring this… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: US court blocks Trump-era H-1B visa fee hike
item.description: Two US district courts have temporarily blocked the enforcement of a Trump-era policy that imposed a $100,000 fee on H-1B visa applications, specifically impacting Indian technology firms. This policy, which aimed to increase fines for… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: ATM Burglars Steal Over Rs 30 Lakh in Shamshabad
item.description: Burglars cut open an ATM in Shamshabad using a gas cutter and stole approximately Rs 30 to Rs 32 lakh in cash. The incident occurred early on Tuesday, October 6. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.
